how_to_apply: Applications are accepted only online. No other mode of application will be accepted.
Go to the MbPA website www.mumbaiport.gov.in and open the "People & Career/Jobs" menu.
Click "APPLY ONLINE", then choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter your name, contact details and email ID.
Note down the Provisional Registration Number and Password shown on screen (also sent by email and SMS).
Fill in the application form. You can use "SAVE AND NEXT" to save and verify details before final submission.
Upload the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration as per the specifications.
Preview the entire form and click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" only after checking every detail. No change is possible after this.
Click the "Payment" tab and pay the fee online.
Click "Submit", then take a printout of the application form and e-receipt. If no e-receipt is generated, the payment has failed and should be repeated by logging in again.

Candidates must also capture and upload a live photograph using a webcam or mobile phone. The declaration text is: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required." Candidates need a valid personal email ID and mobile number that stay active until the recruitment process ends.

content_sections.heading: MbPA Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the qualification, experience, age and nationality conditions for the post they apply for. Candidates can apply for more than one post if eligible, but a separate application with separate fees is needed for each post. Only one application should be submitted per discipline. If a candidate submits multiple applications for the same discipline, only the latest valid completed application is kept and the fees paid for the others are forfeited. Qualifications must be from recognized Indian Universities approved by the UGC or recognized Indian Institutes approved by AICTE. Candidates must hold the valid mark-sheet, degree, diploma, certificate or membership and the required experience as on 01/09/2026. The final result of the qualification must have been published on or before 01/09/2026. Assistant Security Officer candidates must also meet the minimum physical requirements: height 165 cm; chest 81 cm at full expiration and 86 cm after full inspiration (with a difference of at least 5 cm between the two); weight 50 kg. Age is counted as on 01/09/2026. The minimum age is 18 years for all posts. The maximum age depends on the post. Age relaxation for OBC candidates is not specified in the provided notification. SC, ST or OBC candidates who apply for a post under the UR category are not eligible for age relaxation. Candidates claiming relaxation must submit copies of the certificates and produce the originals at verification. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly. A candidate must be (a) a citizen of India, (b) a subject of Nepal, (c) a subject of Bhutan, (d) a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 to settle permanently, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from Pakistan, Burma (Myanmar), Sri Lanka, East African countries of Kenya, Uganda, the United Republic of Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia or Vietnam to settle permanently in India. Candidates in categories (b), (c) and (d) need a certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India. PwBD candidates can apply only for the posts in which their disability is identified as suitable. The full list of abbreviations is given in the official notification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Mumbai Port Authority to fill various Class I and Class II posts under Direct Recruitment for eligible candidates across multiple engineering and administrative departments.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 25 vacancies available for various Class I and Class II posts including civil engineering, electrical/mechanical, accounts, traffic, estate, and security management roles.

faq.question: Q3. What is the starting date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online registration and fee payment process for the Mumbai Port Authority recruitment begins on 29 September 2026. Candidates can submit their applications through the official website starting from this date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The final date to complete and submit your online application form along with the required fee payment is 28 October 2026. All candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree or Diploma in Engineering, Chartered Accountancy (ICAI/ICWAI), or a recognized University Degree depending on the specific post requirements mentioned in the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Mumbai Port Authority recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limits vary depending on the post, generally ranging from a minimum of 18 years up to maximum limits of 30 or 35 years, with permissible age relaxations for reserved categories as per rules.

faq.question: Q7. How much is the application fee for general candidates?
faq.answer: For general and all other candidates not belonging to exempted categories, the application fee is Rs. 750/- plus applicable GST at 18%, payable via the online payment gateway.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process typically includes an online examination, document verification, interview for Class I posts, and specialized physical or language tests for specific posts like Assistant Security Officer.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official website to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates can access the official recruitment portal and apply online by visiting the official Mumbai Port Authority website at www.mumbaiport.gov.in under the 'People & Career/Jobs' section.

faq.answer: Selected candidates for Executive Engineer and equivalent posts placed in the pay scale of Rs. 50000-160000 will receive total emoluments of approximately Rs. 94,500/- per month plus HRA.
